annotations.title: Check a page's AI citation readiness

description: Check how easy one page is for AI answer engines (ChatGPT search, Perplexity, Google's AI Overviews, Claude) to quote: a clear answer in its first 100 words, question-shaped headings and FAQ markup, numbers, sources and quotations, a named author, a last-updated date, lists and tables, a Markdown version, and whether the AI answer crawlers may fetch it — each check pass / improve / fix with how to fix it. A score is not a citation. It fetches that one page as our crawler (MakerRadarBot), after the site's robots.txt, and stores nothing. at most 20 checks an hour per network and 30 an hour per site checked.

url.description: The public page to check (https://…). A bare host means its homepage.

name: check_ai_citation_readiness

checks.description: Fails first. `fix` is the one action to take; null on a pass.

facts.description: What was read, as labelled rows. From the site or a registry: unverified.

listing.description: Whether the site is listed on the directory: its page when it is (and claimUrl while nobody has proven they own it), where to list it when not.

toolUrl.description: The same check as a page on the site.
